1.explanation:
• src/components/Tile/Tile.js is where the click-handler logic lives (lines 228 and 239–247 in the upstream code) and is directly responsible for toggling the internal selected state.
• src/components/Tile/TileGroup.js orchestrates multi-selection and shift-click range behavior, which is where the out-of-sync deselection is introduced.
• src/components/Tile/index.js ties together the exports (SelectableTile vs. plain Tile) and is useful to see exactly how the props are forwarded.
• Tile/Tile.mdx documents the API (props like selected, onClick, etc.) so you understand the expected behavior and public contract.
• TileGroup/TileGroup.mdx shows how consumers are intended to wire up multi-select behavior (including shift-click) and what examples the docs provide for grouping tiles.
1.bug_scenario: When doing a shift-click range selection of SelectableTiles, the last tile in the range (even if its “selected” prop is true) toggles off instead of remaining selected. In the screen-recording you can see four tiles rendered, you click tile 1, then Shift-click tile 4 expecting tiles 1–4 to all be selected, but the fourth tile immediately clears—even though your state (and the selected prop) remain true.
